rows.country: Every market: X translates each post for its reader
rows.caption:
You press Play. A page says "install the VPN app to keep watching". Back, press again: "Your iPhone is severely damaged by (12) virus!" Again: "You are today's lucky visitor."

The page lays an invisible layer over Play, so your tap goes to an ad first.

Undirect takes that layer's tap away, so Play just plays. It's a Safari extension, $1.99 once.
undirect.matsuokengo.com

poll.q: Does your ad blocker stop the tabs that open when you tap?

first_comment.label: Our first reply
first_comment.text:
Blockers hide ads. The tab that opens when you press Play is the page taking your tap, and a blocker has nothing to hide there. Undirect stops that part, so run both.
undirect.matsuokengo.com
